description: CCG Whole Energy System Model Starter Data Kits (one kit per country) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Fernando Plazas-Niño (Loughborough University). This Starter Data Kit provides structured annual data covering historical values and/or projections for the period 2023–2050. The dataset encompasses the full energy system, including the following sectors: residential, transport, industry, services, and agriculture. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 65 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
